---
title: Fit options
aliases:
  - options.html
---

All v2 configuration is passed to `fit()`, so separate model fits do not share
mutable global state.

## ARIMA/GARCH order

`order=(p, d, q)` controls the ARIMA mean process. `garch_order=(k, m)`
controls the GARCH variance process. Set `vol="GARCH"` or `vol="EGARCH"`.

```{python}
#| eval: false
results = model.fit(order=(1, 1, 0), garch_order=(1, 1), vol="GARCH")
```

## Effects

Pass an `Effects` instance with `group`, `time`, and `variance` set to
`"none"`, `"fixed"`, or `"random"`.

```{python}
#| eval: false
effects = pt.Effects(group="random", time="fixed", variance="none")
results = model.fit(effects=effects)
```

## Optimizer and covariance

Use `OptimizerOptions` for `tolerance`, `max_iterations`, `accuracy`,
`use_analytical_hessian`, and the other optimizer controls. Select covariance
behavior with `cov_type` and `robust_cov_lags`.

```{python}
#| eval: false
optimizer = pt.OptimizerOptions(tolerance=1e-5, max_iterations=150)
results = model.fit(optimizer=optimizer, cov_type="robust")
```

## Constraints

Use `constraints=` for coefficient restrictions and `add_intercept`,
`subtract_means`, `include_initvar`, `tobit_limits`, and `suppress_output` for
fit behavior.

## Custom model and h-function

Pass a likelihood instance with `likelihood=` or a SymPy expression with
`h_function=`. See the [custom likelihood guide](../guide/custom-likelihood-models.qmd)
and [heteroskedasticity guide](../guide/heteroskedasticity-functions.qmd).

## Migrating from `pt.options`

| v1 | v2 |
|---|---|
| `pqdkm` | `order=` and `garch_order=` |
| `EGARCH` | `vol="EGARCH"` |
| `fixed_random_group_eff`, `fixed_random_time_eff`, `fixed_random_variance_eff` | `effects=pt.Effects(...)` |
| `custom_model` | `likelihood=` (an instance) |
| `user_constraints` | `constraints=` |
| `use_analytical` | `optimizer.use_analytical_hessian` |
| `supress_output` | `suppress_output=` |
